subject: English
title: CISCE curriculum: English, Class V

source.read: A third-party copy of the Class V pages of the CISCE curriculum (English: printed pages 24 to 30), hosted by BYJU'S
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The pages do not name their publisher or year, and were read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The official document on cisce.org could not be reached from the build environment. CISCE is understood not to prescribe a textbook for Class V, so a school's own book and term plan may order or extend these topics.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words with a pointer to its strand and line; no curriculum text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from a secondary source; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Shares and explains ideas and points of view clearly.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Asks and answers questions on a topic.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Interprets and analyses what is heard.
outcomes.note: Listen and answer: questions on a passage heard.

outcomes.text: Judges and draws conclusions from the key details heard.
outcomes.note: Listen and answer: questions on details, causes and what can be worked out.

outcomes.text: Uses other resources, such as online material, to support class learning.
outcomes.note: Outside the app.

outcomes.text: Reads a speaker's spoken and unspoken messages.
outcomes.note: Speaking and watching a speaker are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Makes personal connections and compares ideas and information.
outcomes.note: Discussion is not in the app.

outcomes.text: Speaks with suitable gestures, eye contact and a clear pace.
outcomes.note: Speaking is not practised in the app.

outcomes.text: Takes dictation of an unseen passage.
outcomes.note: Listen and write dictates unseen sentences one at a time, not a whole passage.

outcomes.text: Finds the main points of a text and the details that support them.
outcomes.note: Reading course: finding details and the main idea.

outcomes.text: Follows the broad outline of a story.
outcomes.note: Reading course: order of events.

outcomes.text: Explains events, steps or ideas: what happened and why.
outcomes.note: Reading course: cause and effect.

outcomes.text: Links opinions to reasons with words, phrases and clauses.
outcomes.note: Joining ideas with because, so and although is practised; writing an opinion is not. Reading covers telling fact from opinion.

outcomes.text: Works out the meaning of words and phrases, including similes.
outcomes.note: New words teaches meanings in sentences; figurative language such as similes is not taught.

outcomes.text: Uses technology to gather information for a project.
outcomes.note: Outside the app.

outcomes.text: Writes at least two paragraphs, about 150 words, on a topic.
outcomes.note: Paragraph and essay writing is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Writes a narrative with events, actions, thoughts and feelings.
outcomes.note: Story writing is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Arranges sentences in a sensible order.
outcomes.note: Reading covers the order of events; arranging whole sentences into a paragraph is not practised.

outcomes.text: Uses linking words such as firstly, then, later and finally.
outcomes.note: Grammar in use: building sentences with linking words.

outcomes.text: Writes short notes on self, diversity and responsible behaviour.
outcomes.note: Free writing is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Uses words and phrases suited to the class, including ones for feelings and actions.
outcomes.note: New words teaches level-appropriate words; it is not organised by feelings and actions.

outcomes.text: Follows the steps of writing: plan, write, revise, edit, rewrite.
outcomes.note: The writing process is being built separately.

outcomes.text: Uses vocabulary that fits different fields, such as cookery, yoga and sports.
outcomes.note: New words teaches general vocabulary, not sets by field.

outcomes.text: Understands and uses adverbs and their kinds.
Uses conjunctions, prepositions and interjections.
Knows the meaning and use of common idioms, proverbs and phrasal verbs.
outcomes.note: A small set of proverbs and phrasal verbs is practised; idioms are not yet.

outcomes.text: Uses plural possessives, comparisons of adjectives and adverbs, apostrophes in short forms and possessive pronouns.
Uses irregular verbs in the simple and continuous tenses.
Spells commonly used words correctly.
outcomes.note: The Spelling Bee, and words misspelt in writing that return as My tricky words.

outcomes.text: Uses direct and reported speech in dialogue.
Makes subjects and verbs agree, with growing skill.
Builds simple and compound sentences and punctuates them.
outcomes.note: Named under the strand's content rather than as a numbered outcome.

outcomes.text: Reads literary and other texts from a suggested list (stories, abridged classics, biographies, diaries).
outcomes.note: The app holds no literature. Its reading texts are OpenPath's own short passages. A school's chosen book can be added through My Books.
